name: OpenData_StormwaterProblemAreas
snippet: This dataset is to be used to provide vector data for Planning & Zoning analysis in Santa Rosa County. The dataset is also to be used for planning purposes for various county and private agencies and to provide GIS feature mapping.
description: This dataset is an ArcGIS Shapefile representing areas that Planning & Zoning has determined to be Stormwater Draininage Problem Areas for use in the Minor Subdivision Review Process. The specific area's were identified by Roger Blaylock, County Engineer, Road & Bridge Foreman for each Commission District, and data received from Roads & Bridges during the April 2006 100 Year Flood Event. The Digital DFRIM was appended to the layer to replace FEMA Q3 data in April 2009.
